name: minicycle-desktop
description: miniCycle desktop app — Electron shell wrapping the byte-identical web app (web/).
//: The web payload (www/) is GENERATED from web/ by web/scripts/build-desktop-www.cjs. Never hand-edit www/. The version field is APP_VERSION plus a trailing .0 (electron-builder requires semver; the app uses two parts), synced by web/scripts/update-version.sh --desktop. See docs/DESKTOP_BUILD_AND_DIFFERENCES.md.

scripts.smoke:offline: npm run build:www && MINICYCLE_SMOKE=dist/smoke-offline.png MINICYCLE_SMOKE_OFFLINE=1 electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build:www && npm run installers
